records.title: Recurrent Preference Memory for Efficient Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
records.reason: Rec2PM compresses long user histories into recurrent preference memory and reports inference memory/latency gains, but it is a generative recommender-specific architecture rather than a general-purpose LLM inference method.

records.title: TVCACHE: A Stateful Tool-Value Cache for Post-Training LLM Agents
records.reason: TVCACHE caches external tool outputs during RL post-training rollouts; it is explicitly a post-training cost optimization, not model inference serving.

records.title: Routing Absorption in Sparse Attention: Why Random Gates Are Hard to Beat
records.reason: The paper studies learned sparse attention, gate co-adaptation, and post-hoc sparsification with some Qwen3 evaluation. Primary results show deployment quality penalties and limited scale/generalization, making it useful as a limitation/negative-result source rather than a confirmed efficient method.

records.title: Expert Divergence Learning for MoE-based Language Models
records.reason: Expert Divergence Learning is an MoE pretraining strategy and explicitly reports training-side compute overhead, outside inference efficiency.
